queries.query: बरेली भू नक्शा उत्तर प्रदेश खसरा नक्शा आधिकारिक
queries.scope: Confirm Bareilly-specific local cadastral coverage and inspect the official map selector.
queries.result: Bareilly district’s official land-record page links UP Bhulekh. The official UP Bhunaksha selector identifies Bareilly district code 150, its Bareilly tehsil code 00787, and returns 417 village records under that tehsil. The exact WUP point’s village and parcel geometry were not resolved.
queries.executionMethod: Official district page and read-only POST selector requests to UP BhuNaksha.

queries.query: Bareilly official cadastral map Bhu Naksha Uttar Pradesh land records map sheets
queries.scope: Check city-specific state map records and georeferencing data.
queries.result: The official UP dashboard identifies Bareilly district and reports its georeferenced cadastral map progress; this is not point-level parcel proof. The state viewer’s anonymous selector works for Bareilly, but its plot lookup requires a selected village GIS code and projected map coordinates, which are not known for the WUP centroid.
queries.executionMethod: Official web search and direct read-only selector API inspection.
